info.title: WorkerAI – Claude Task Monitor API
info.description: REST API for WorkerAI, a task management platform for tracking AI-assisted work across projects. All endpoints require session authentication (cookie set via POST /api/auth) unless otherwise noted. Webhook delivery uses HMAC-SHA256 signing via X-Webhook-Signature header.

post.description: Validates the password and sets a session cookie.
